pastime:shogi:page#f3dgiv.en: Fuku's bench, on the hill above Saltglass harbour

pastime:shogi:page#1biqfg7.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi:page#1biqfg7.jp: {取|と}った {駒|こま} は {自分|じぶん} の {駒|こま} に なる 。
pastime:shogi:page#1biqfg7.en: Two armies of wedge-shaped pieces on a nine-by-nine board. A captured piece changes sides and can be dropped back into play: nothing is ever quite out of the game.

pastime:shogi:page#17a45wr.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi:page#17a45wr.jp: {一手|いって} ずつ {駒|こま} を {動|うご}かす 。
pastime:shogi:page#17a45wr.en: Take turns moving one piece. Each kind of piece moves its own way; the lessons show each one.

pastime:shogi:page#11f8bef.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi:page#11f8bef.jp: {取|と}った {駒|こま} は {持|も}ち{駒|ごま} 。 {空|あ}いて いる ところ に {打|う}てる 。
pastime:shogi:page#11f8bef.en: Land on a piece of theirs to capture it. It goes into your hand, and on a later turn you may drop it on any empty square instead of moving.

pastime:shogi:page#vvepod.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi:page#vvepod.jp: {奥|おく} の {三|さん} {段|だん} に {入|はい}る と {成|な}れる 。
pastime:shogi:page#vvepod.en: Reach the far three ranks and most pieces may promote: they turn over and move differently.

pastime:shogi:page#17a83ug.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi:page#17a83ug.jp: {玉|ぎょく} が {詰|つ}めば {勝|か}ち 。
pastime:shogi:page#17a83ug.en: Attack the king so it has nowhere safe to go, and the game is yours: checkmate.

pastime:shogi#1ytgjt4.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#1ytgjt4.jp: {歩|ふ} は {前|まえ} に {一|ひと}つ {進|すす}む 。 {取|と}る の も {前|まえ} 。
pastime:shogi#1ytgjt4.en: The pawn steps straight forward, one square, and takes the same way. Take the pawn in front of it.

pastime:shogi#gmvsi.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#gmvsi.jp: {香車|きょうしゃ} は {前|まえ} に どこ まで も {進|すす}める 。 {後|うし}ろ に は {戻|もど}れない 。
pastime:shogi#gmvsi.en: The lance runs straight forward as far as it likes, but never back. Take the pawn up its file.

pastime:shogi#7vcfss.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#7vcfss.jp: {桂馬|けいま} は {二|ふた}つ {前|まえ} 、 {一|ひと}つ {横|よこ} に {跳|と}ぶ 。
pastime:shogi#7vcfss.en: The knight jumps: two forward and one to the side, over anything in the way. Jump onto the pawn.

pastime:shogi#2do3q4.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#2do3q4.jp: {銀|ぎん} は {前|まえ} と {斜|なな}め に {一|ひと}つ {進|すす}む 。
pastime:shogi#2do3q4.en: The silver steps one square forward or diagonally, five ways in all, but never straight to the side or straight back. Take the pawn diagonally ahead.

pastime:shogi#16ue5o2.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#16ue5o2.jp: {金|きん} は {斜|なな}め {後|うし}ろ {以外|いがい} に {一|ひと}つ {動|うご}く 。
pastime:shogi#16ue5o2.en: The gold steps one square any way but diagonally back. Take the pawn beside it.

pastime:shogi#1l5kpq1.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#1l5kpq1.jp: {角|かく} は {斜|なな}め に どこ まで も {進|すす}む 。
pastime:shogi#1l5kpq1.en: The bishop slides diagonally as far as the way is clear. Take the pawn in the far corner.

pastime:shogi#1cod03j.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#1cod03j.jp: {飛車|ひしゃ} は {縦|たて} と {横|よこ} に どこ まで も {進|すす}む 。
pastime:shogi#1cod03j.en: The rook slides straight along a rank or a file as far as the way is clear. Move it up its file.

pastime:shogi#10fhg53.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#10fhg53.jp: {玉|ぎょく} は どの {方向|ほうこう} に も {一|ひと}つ {進|すす}む 。
pastime:shogi#10fhg53.en: The king steps one square any way. Keep it safe: if it is caught, the game is lost. Take the pawn next to it.

pastime:shogi#1ena15p.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#1ena15p.jp: {一手詰|いってづ}め 。 {持|も}ち{駒|ごま} の {金|きん} で 。
pastime:shogi#1ena15p.en: Mate in one: a gold from your hand.

pastime:shogi#1btl4uw.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#1btl4uw.jp: {一手詰|いってづ}め 。 {玉|ぎょく} は {隅|すみ} に いる 。
pastime:shogi#1btl4uw.en: Mate in one: the king is in the corner.

pastime:shogi#zs2yo8.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#zs2yo8.jp: {一手詰|いってづ}め 。 {本将棋|ほんしょうぎ} の {盤|ばん} で 。
pastime:shogi#zs2yo8.en: Mate in one, on the full board.

pastime:shogi#14nqyo9.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#14nqyo9.jp: {一手詰|いってづ}め 。 {飛車|ひしゃ} で 。
pastime:shogi#14nqyo9.en: Mate in one: the rook. The king's own pawns hem it in.

pastime:shogi#vnv6nf.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#vnv6nf.jp: {一手詰|いってづ}め 。 {持|も}ち{駒|ごま} の {桂馬|けいま} で 。
pastime:shogi#vnv6nf.en: Mate in one: a knight from your hand. Only a knight can jump past the king's guards.

pastime:shogi#1a08186.ref: self-reviewed by the lead against the game's lexicon, standard shogi terminology (piece names, handicap names, 一手詰め) and textbook grammar (P06)
pastime:shogi#1a08186.jp: {一手詰|いってづ}め 。 {歩|ふ} が {成|な}れば 、 {金|きん} の よう に {動|うご}く 。
pastime:shogi#1a08186.en: Mate in one: the pawn. A pawn that promotes moves like a gold.
